name: Tadiran Group Ltd
summary: Tadiran Group Ltd engages in the import, marketing, distribution, and sale of air conditioners and air conditioning systems in Israel, Europe, and internationally. The company operates through the Consumer Goods, Energy, and Other segments. It offers air conditioners and air conditioning systems under the Tadiran, Amcor, SFERA, Toshiba, and Spectra brands; and central cooling units under the Aermec brand; fan coil blowers; refrigerators, washing machines, dryers, freezers, ovens, and microwaves under the Amcor and Crystal brands, as well as heat pumps.
